data.title: 橘美花莉 · 海滨主题咖啡的限定造型
data.description: 【漫展外景海滩·午后】美花莉穿着金色系泳装与半透明罩衫坐在主题咖啡摊旁，手里端着印有米莉艾拉图案的冰饮；她把栗棕长发拨到肩后面对镜头摆出宣传姿势，海风让小翅膀配件与粉色发带轻轻晃动。
data.action: 主题海滩咖啡摊旁举限定冰饮摆宣传姿势，海风吹拂栗棕发与粉色缎带后笑场
data.lighting: warm afternoon sun on gold fabric and water
data.mood: 把角色扮演活成真正的夏日舞台
data.promptProse: Mikari Tachibana sits beside the convention's themed beach cafe stall, holding the Miriella-patterned iced drink and brushing chestnut hair behind her shoulder for the camera. Her metallic-gold swimsuit, light black wrap and little wing accessories remain clear with pink hair ties. The horizontal medium portrait includes the stall counter and sea beyond. Afternoon sun lights gold fabric and cup condensation, while ocean reflections flicker beneath the wrap's shaded folds.
